topic: Theory: Joy Boy's treasure on Laugh Tale is the laugh itself, an answer to his Fish-Man Island apology, and Luffy's Gear 5 is that answer
title: Joy Boy's Treasure Was Never Gold, It Was A Laugh
description: Roger found Joy Boy's treasure and laughed so hard he named the island Laugh Tale. Here's my read on why the treasure was never gold, and how Joy Boy's apology and Luffy's Gear 5 connect to that laugh. Do you buy it?
comment: Did Roger laugh at a cruel joke about history, or at Joy Boy's answer to his own apology? Pick one.

lines.text: Joy Boy's treasure was never gold. It was a laugh.
